definitions.gloss: cedar forest; grove of cedar trees
definitions.explanation: A wood or plantation consisting of Japanese cedar ({杉|すぎ}). Large planted cedar forests are common in Japan and are a major source of springtime pollen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{杉林|すぎばやし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{覆|おお}われている→覆う：02020_oou⟧。
examples.english: The mountain is covered with cedar forest.

examples.japanese: {杉林|すぎばやし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walked along the path running through the cedar forest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{杉林|すぎばやし}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花粉|かふん}→花粉：04372_kafun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}んで→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧くる。
examples.english: When spring comes, huge amounts of pollen blow in from this cedar forest.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{杉|すぎ}→杉：03889_sugi⟧ (Japanese cedar) + ⟦{林|はやし}→林：01702_hayashi⟧ (woods). The はやし reading voices to ばやし in this compound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {杉林|すぎばやし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: a cedar forest spreads out
- {杉林|すぎばやし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{囲|かこ}まれる→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧: be surrounded by cedar forest
- {杉林|すぎばやし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花粉|かふん}→花粉：04372_kafun⟧: pollen from a cedar forest

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧: forest — larger and denser, often with mixed trees; ⟦{林|はやし}→林：01702_hayashi⟧ (as in {杉林|すぎばやし}) is a smaller or single-species wood.
